unknown_path_policy.rule: A production mutation is unsupported unless its actor, target resource, lock or transaction boundary, and rollback surface are present in this registry. Callers must reject an unknown path before it writes.
unknown_path_policy.enforcement_status: This inventory is authoritative now; runtime admission enforcement is intentionally deferred to the bounded follow-on tasks below.

follow_on_hook_points.hook: production mutation admission check at governed installer and deploy entry points
follow_on_hook_points.purpose: Reject a requested resource mutation that has no registry actor/resource mapping.
Enforce the one logical executor dispatch surface named by this registry.

current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.kind: exclusive no-follow file lock and install transaction
current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.behavior: Verifies sources, snapshots every destination, writes atomically, and restores snapshots on failure.

rollback_surface.surface: ~/.hermes/logs/fleet-config-installs/<receipt>/destinations
rollback_surface.procedure: Installer rollback restores planned snapshots; operator may inspect the receipt before a targeted recovery.

current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.kind: directory lease and atomic release pointer swap
current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.behavior: Builds and validates a fresh release before atomically repointing runtime-current; serializes cuts, rollback, and prune.

rollback_surface.surface: ~/.hermes/releases/.previous and .mini-release-last-receipt.json
rollback_surface.procedure: mini-release-cut.sh --rollback repoints runtime-current to the verified previous release and restarts services.

actors.name: Ignite skills synchronization

current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.kind: named skill pull and catalog update leases
current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.behavior: The script acquires both leases, validates canonical roots, records the catalog generation, and releases only matching tokens.

rollback_surface.surface: /Users/colingreig/dev/ignite-skills-live Git checkout and catalog-generation receipt
rollback_surface.procedure: Failing pulls publish a failed generation; recovery is a reviewed fast-forward or repository rollback before the next pull.

actors.notes: The execution brief uses the historic sync_ignite_skills_to_hermes.sh name. The currently deployed governed entry point is ignite-skills-pull.sh.

current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.kind: fenced SQLite lease
current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.behavior: Both executor cron IDs enter one lease identity; BEGIN IMMEDIATE and monotonically increasing fencing tokens reject overlap.

rollback_surface.surface: ClickUp evidence handoffs and executor lease history
rollback_surface.procedure: Release or recover a lease through the admission ledger; revert repository work by its governed commit/PR workflow, never by deleting shared state.

current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.kind: cron jobs advisory lock plus validator evidence gate
current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.behavior: Scheduler serializes persisted job metadata; validator status mutation requires its proof packet and finalize token.

rollback_surface.surface: ClickUp validator comments and repository CI/PR evidence
rollback_surface.procedure: Correct a false verdict with a new evidence-backed validator action; no local state rewrite is treated as a rollback.

current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.kind: cron jobs advisory lock and ordered reconciliation pass
current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.behavior: Scheduler serializes job metadata; the job runs closeout, stalled-task, staleness, then reconciliation in order.

rollback_surface.surface: ClickUp task event/comment history
rollback_surface.procedure: Repair incorrect remote lifecycle state with a subsequent audited reconciliation, preserving history.

current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.kind: cron jobs advisory lock and gate-local idempotency
current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.behavior: The no-agent scheduler serializes its metadata while the poll gate owns its ClickUp eligibility checks.

rollback_surface.surface: ClickUp task event history and cron output
rollback_surface.procedure: Correct an incorrect gate action through a subsequent guarded ClickUp reconciliation.

current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.kind: cron jobs advisory lock and packaged review-poll guard
current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.behavior: The compatibility entry point delegates to pr_pipeline.review_poll_gate.safe_main, which owns the guarded poll state transition.

rollback_surface.surface: PR pipeline state and cron output
rollback_surface.procedure: A follow-up guarded poll reconciles the review state; inspect its output before any targeted pipeline recovery.

actors.name: Fleet health digest cron

current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.kind: cron jobs advisory lock
current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.behavior: The prompt explicitly forbids config, skill, cron, and ClickUp writes; scheduler-only job metadata remains serialized by the cron lock.

rollback_surface.surface: Digest email and sender receipt
rollback_surface.procedure: No Hermes-owned production resource is changed by the digest; delivery correction is a subsequent digest or sender retry.

actors.notes: Email delivery is an external side effect, but this actor is read-only for Hermes production resources.

current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.kind: cron jobs advisory lock and script-local deletion guards
current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.behavior: Scheduler serializes metadata; each cleanup script owns its dry-run and deletion eligibility checks.

rollback_surface.surface: Git worktree/ref recovery and retained .bak files
rollback_surface.procedure: Deletion is deliberately safety-gated; recover a removed worktree from its retained repository ref or backup rather than forcing a script past its guard.

current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.kind: machine-global advisory lock and SQLite transactions
current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.behavior: Only the lock holder dispatches; board and session writes use their SQLite transaction contracts.

rollback_surface.surface: Kanban event log and SQLite backups
rollback_surface.procedure: Stop the competing gateway, reconcile from event history, and restore only a verified database backup when lifecycle recovery requires it.

current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.kind: SQLite WAL transaction
current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.behavior: Session DB writers are WAL multi-writer tolerant, subject to the lifecycle contract tracked by 86e2kmud2 rather than a fleet singleton.

rollback_surface.surface: SQLite backup and session lifecycle records
rollback_surface.procedure: Recover using the session DB lifecycle procedure; never treat a WAL-capable session store as a fleet-wide single-writer resource.
